I was unable to sleep last whole night because of the worst food experience and food my close friends and guest consumed last night.

•	No proper cutlery: They didn’t even have basic serving bowls or forks ready. Guests were served noodles with disposable wooden forks at the last moment. However, since afternoon I kept asking them to show me where are forks and they said it’s inside.

Food quality: the main course menu was - noodles, manchurian gravy, pasta & pav bhaji.
•	Veg Manchurian gravy was watery and tasteless.
•	white Pasta had no taste and watery
•	Pav Bhaji was even poorly prepared and inedible.
Noodles were very ok ok types, not good.

We repeatedly checked with Mr. Pramod about their chef’s ability to handle pasta and other dishes, but despite assurances, the results were disappointing. The entire experience left us embarrassed in front of our guests.

Honestly, the only thing I’m thankful for is that some guests couldn’t make it and were spared this experience.
